public_rationale: The reported results concern development automation and a possible route to RSI. They do not demonstrate Marcus's broad definition of AGI. This supports the distinction about demonstrated capability, not a stronger claim that these results offer no information about eventual AGI.

The live report was subsequently updated; relevant contents were corroborated against the preserved June copy.
